note: Starting vault for Kettleworks Coffee, a fictional neighbourhood roaster used as a test brand. Every item is invented: no real company, person, place or figure. The numbers and prices are round and illustrative only. Imported once on an empty database; edit or delete in the app afterwards.

vault.title: Batches a week
vault.body: We roast two batches a week, every Monday and Thursday (illustrative figure).

vault.title: Rest after roasting
vault.body: Beans rest for 48 hours after roasting before they are ground (illustrative figure).

vault.title: Stamp card
vault.body: Ten stamps on the card; the tenth coffee is free (illustrative offer).

vault.title: The morning board
vault.body: Espresso €2, flat white €3, oat latte €4, filter of the day €3 (round, illustrative prices).

vault.title: House blend
vault.body: The house espresso blend, sold in 250 g bags for €12 (illustrative price).

vault.title: Opening hours
vault.body: Open every day from 7:00 to 18:00 at 12 Kettle Lane, Brookmere, an invented town.

vault.title: Tasting night
vault.body: A tasting night at the roastery on 12 December at 19:00; entry €10 with a coffee included (invented event).

vault.title: Milk
vault.body: Oat, soy and whole milk at no extra cost.
